title: Does holding picks for multiple days (same stop-loss/floor rules, no forced EOD exit) beat today's day-trading?

tables.name: Win rate / avg return by hold period ($300 total capital, per-trade basis, no capital recycling modeled)

notes: Baseline (live, hold=1d): TRAIN win_rate=68.2%, VAL win_rate=71.0%. Recommendation from this run: [3, 5, 10]. Does NOT model capital recycling -- see swing_hold_compounding_check.py for the version that does, which is what actually determined the live MAX_HOLD_DAYS value.

conclusion.summary: Swing trading (multi-day hold) shipped 2026-07-24 based on this test. MAX_HOLD_DAYS itself was later revised from 5 to 3 (2026-07-28) once swing_hold_compounding_check.py modeled real capital recycling across a 3-slot portfolio -- this script's own hold-period recommendation didn't account for that.
